releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.46.1 alpha
changes: Adds native CAD tables with typed cells, merged ranges, styles and overrides. Cells can reference blocks and fields. The model stores formulas, data links, saved cell values and optional table graphics. Studio handles recalculation and refresh.
Adds shared preservation for selected ModelSpace MLINE content. Several preserved roots can refer to one stored Document selection package. Studio retains blocked roots when editing and saving IFCX.
Explorer uses the official Document and Studio integrations. It shows the backing package in the inspection graph and adds one parts-list table to the existing entity catalogue.
[Document table mapping](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencaddocument/pull/18)
[Document shared preservation](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/opencaddocument/pull/19)
[Studio table commands](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/pull/2914)
[Studio shared preservation](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/pull/2957)

releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.46.0 alpha
changes: Adds classic Leader, MultiLeader and Tolerance, with typed owned parts, annotation references and supplied graphics.

Adds standalone splines, Hatch spline edges and Paper viewport spline clips. The Document route keeps control and fit data where the target can carry them. DWG output diagnoses omitted fit data in mixed definitions. Strict spline export refuses a target that would lose that data.

Adds compact Leader, MultiLeader and open cubic spline samples to the Explorer entity catalogue. The Leader sample includes a Tolerance annotation. Explorer includes the merged Studio correction for drawing compact periodic splines. The build pins Document `b7f02ad6`, acadrust `acad0df2` and Studio `668ae67b`. The codec pin includes the rational-weight DXF correction.
